# Personal View

> > Personal View is a community and resource platform currently undergoing server configuration and setup.

The site appears to be in an early deployment phase with CentOS-WebPanel infrastructure being configured. Full content and community features are expected to be available once server installation is complete.

## Key Topics

- CentOS-WebPanel
- Server Configuration
- Web Hosting Panel
- CentOS Linux
- HTTP Server
- CWP Control Panel
- Server Installation
- Web Hosting Infrastructure
- Linux Server Management
- Domain Configuration

## Server Infrastructure

- [HTTP Server Test Page powered by CentOS-WebPanel.com](https://per.personal-view.com/): CentOS-WebPanel HTTP server test page for installation verification
- [HTTP Server Test Page powered by CentOS-WebPanel.com](http://ftp.personal-view.com/): CentOS-WebPanel HTTP server test page for FTP subdomain
